title: Decide commercialization model: open source / open core / source-available / proprietary / hosted-first
description: Decide the commercialization and source-licensing model for Loreweaver. Options: fully open source, open core (open base + proprietary extensions), source-available, proprietary/closed, or hosted-first (service-only). This decision determines the final source-code license to apply and unblocks publishing decisions (see loreweaver-0jq.26).
acceptance_criteria: A commercialization model is chosen and recorded (ADR or bead note), with rationale. The decision identifies the resulting source-code license direction and any constraints on contributions and distribution.
close_reason: Accepted source-available community/commercial licensing model. Initial source-code license direction is PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0. CLI may be free for non-commercial use; Eshyra should be described as source-available/free for non-commercial use, not open source. Commercial rights are reserved; commercial embedding, hosted-service operation, resale, paid integration, commercial redistribution, and paid content/rules/campaign-pack redistribution require separate written permission or a separate commercial license. Rules/content artifacts may carry separate licenses and third-party rules content remains governed by its own license and attribution requirements.
